mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to price in lower future earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, increasing the likelihood of a near-term recession and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 92.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 2.5%, the market prices in a prolonged high-interest-rate environment, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising residential construction starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a tight labor market that may trigger wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with inflation risk
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 5 months, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO), signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
